insight: Founded by ex-Google PM and former Flipkart CPO Punit Soni; its $70M 2024 Series D brought total funding to $165M.
name: Suki
tagline: Ambient AI assistant for clinicians — notes, dictation, coding and orders from the visit.
description: An AI assistant for clinicians that listens to the patient conversation and generates complete clinical notes, then goes further than a scribe: it takes dictation, suggests medical codes, answers questions and stages orders. Integrates in real time with Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth and MEDITECH, and is used across 400+ health systems and 100+ specialties.
edge: Pairs ambient notes with dictation, coding and clinical Q&A in one assistant, with deep two-way EHR integration across Epic, Oracle Health and more.

references.title: Suki raises $70M to expand healthcare AI scribe
